content: Plan: 1) Run proto-blue-codegen via manifest-path invocation against lexicons/polaris/ to populate polaris-lexicons/src/generated/. 2) Create polaris-lexicons/Cargo.toml with serde+serde_json+chrono workspace deps, no tokio/reqwest. 3) Create polaris-lexicons/src/lib.rs with #![deny(missing_docs)] + pub mod generated. 4) Create polaris-lexicons/README.md. 5) Add polaris-lexicons to workspace members (alphabetical: after polaris-frontend, before polaris-publish-did-service). 6) Add xtask/src/gen_lexicons.rs that shells out to proto-blue-codegen via manifest-path. 7) Wire into xtask lib.rs + main.rs. 8) Add CI step to .github/workflows/ci.yml after cargo test. 9) Verify all build targets + clippy + doc.
